mapper.insert: INSERT INTO help_request (user_id, title, description, image_url, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO help_reply (help_id, expert_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{helpId}, #{expertId}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM help_request WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM help_request WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DATE(created_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM help_request WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY date
